test: iron auto-hammer processes one stone into cobblestone in Horizon

environment.isolation: fresh HORIZON_HOME, HORIZON_LAUNCHER_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; audio disabled

steps: Loaded the final API 0.5 component with block-entities, item-transfer, machine-slot-limits, recipes, vanilla-hooks, and config capabilities.
Placed ftbsbc:iron_auto_hammer at 0,65,0; Horizon created its 13-slot container.
Inserted minecraft:stone in machine slot 0 using the container control command.
Waited for 60 ticks and inspected the machine container.
scope_limit: Only the iron auto-hammer exact-item stone recipe was exercised. Tag recipes, compressed outputs, other tiers, sided hopper transfer, save/reload progress, and full-pack integration remain unverified.
